items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: That’s his first song. It was a hit. Two minutes and eleven seconds with Leslie Gore. We put it in the album. It didn’t work until they did a picture with a ski movie, and it went almost to number one. We had 18 hits with Leslie. Leslie was almost like the first girl in rock-and-roll, before the Beatles. It’s ridiculous. It’s always to be – I like to do dangerous stuff. “Okay, we’re going to try to go . . .” – Leslie was huge. Still is. Can sing her booty off. She just sang the – we did a thing down here she sang…
